text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a stunning turn of events! Absolutely incredible!
Blowing past all doubts about the distance
and pulling away on that long straightaway...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory for Twin Turbo!!!
This year's Derby Umamusume is not Tokai Teio, but Twin Turbo!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I won... I actually won... Did I really just win...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it, I really did it!
Traineeeeeeer!!!!!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations, that was a huge upset!

text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo ran with everything she had,
blazing wildly through the course. And then—

Tur-bo! Tur-bo!!
Tur-bo! Tur-bo!!

Tur-bo! Tur-bo!!
Tur-bo! Tur-bo!!

Cheers erupt all around. An intense sense of déjà vu washes over me.
Yes, just like last year's Japanese Derby—

"There was an Umamusume who achieved
a similarly dramatic victory."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hallo hallo, Turbo-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Her run was so incredible!
Just watching it gave me chills!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ines! You saw that, right?
Turbo was super awesome, wasn't she!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I have two younger sisters, but~
I'd almost love to adopt Turbo-chan too♪

—Ines Fujin.
The big-sisterly Umamusume who won
last year's Nihon Derby with a wire-to-wire victory.
"Today's brilliant feat happened almost as if she were guided by her. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, Bourbon? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have received the inspiration as well. To think there is also such a way to win the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am still in the Junior Class,
but I shall take this as reference for the future.

—Mihono Bourbon.
Known for her cyborg-like precision front-running,
she also came to offer her congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Next year might be Bourbon's turn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's see how far you can go!
This time, Turbo and Ines will be watching!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

A history of brilliant feats passed down through time. Perhaps this, too,
is one of the lineages of Umamusume.
And after the Winning Live concluded...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer. Someone's coming.
Is that...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way...! Sorry, move!
Please, get out of the way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let me through, please!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: How rare to see the President get so flustered. Did something happen?

A chill crept down my spine. I had a bad feeling.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, Tokai Teio got a fracture~ !?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: How could this be... Not Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She might not even be able to run in the Kikuka-sho...?
You've gotta be kidding me...

That shocking news sent massive ripples through
not just Tracen Academy, but society as a whole.
"If Tokai Teio is absent this autumn, the entire landscape of the Classic Triple Crown will shift drastically, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, Trainer-san.
I have an update... about Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds like she's not giving up on entering the Kikuka-sho.
We don't know if she can make it, but both she and her team are going to do their best."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Well...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo knew it all along, though!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, you look awfully confident!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, that's Tokai Teio we're talking about.
There's no way a broken bone is gonna make
her give up."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Nature!
Turbo and the gang gotta get to work!
Right, Trainer?

Summer training camp season is approaching.
On top of that, our target race,
the Radio NIKKEI Sho, is drawing near.

"Of course I'm concerned about our rivals, but we can't afford
to get entirely caught up in that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right... There's nothing we can do for Teio.
All we can do is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"All that matters is getting stronger! Why am I worrying
about Teio when she's already so far ahead of me!?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do it, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo and the gang just gotta
burst forward with all our might toward autumn!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Nature, both of you believe in Turbo and follow my lead!

Twin Turbo remained endlessly positive.
Undeterred by Tokai Teio's setback,
she keeps barreling down her own path.
